name: Sub Scribe
description: Sub Scribe brings subtitles to Jellyfin from two sources — SubDL.com and tvsubtitles.net: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Each source has its own download and upload switch, a subtitle never goes back to the other source, and the download order is yours to choose. A TMDb API key is required. SubDL is optional: without a SubDL API key (downloads) or login (uploads) that source is skipped and the other one keeps running. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL and tvsubtitles.net — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog: v12.1.12.380: the hearing-impaired pool is walked instead of grabbed, and it carries the main track when the regular pool runs dry — an episode whose pack produced nothing usable is no longer marked "language not available" while its HI uploads sit unused (F-M476).
